question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Jargon
solution:
The correct answer is: **Terminology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Jargon"** means specialized language used by a particular group or profession, often difficult for others to understand. (विशेषज्ञ भाषा)

 
 
• **Example:** Medical **jargon **can be confusing for patients who are not familiar with the terms.
 
 
 
• **"Terminology"** refers to the body of terms used with a particular technical application in a subject of study, profession, etc. (पारिभाषिक शब्दावली)
 
 
• **Example:** The **terminology **used in legal documents can be very complex.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Jargon'** is **'Terminology'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Automobile** (ऑटोमोबाइल): A self-propelled passenger vehicle that usually has four wheels and an internal combustion engine.

 
 
• **Example:** The **automobile **industry has seen rapid growth in recent years.
 
 
 
• **Music** (संगीत): The art or science of combining vocal or instrumental sounds to produce beauty of form, harmony, and expression of emotion.
 
 
• **Example:** She enjoys listening to classical **music **in her free time.
 
 
 
• **Essay** (निबंध): A short piece of writing on a particular subject.
 
 
• **Example:** He wrote an **essay **on the impact of climate change.
